The [[Panda]] is an [[animal companion]] raised in the [[Zaishen Menagerie]]. Like [[Polar Bear|other]] [[Black Bear|bears]] in the game, it deals [[slashing damage]].

==Locations==
*[[The Battle Isles]]
**{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)

== Notes ==

* They are not charmable in the wild. Instead, they can be unlocked by presenting an [[Imperial Panda License]] to [[Emryd the Tamer]].
* Alternatively, they can be unlocked by [[Helena]] (Zaishen Keeper) like any other pet by paying their [[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|''Prestige, Exotic'' Unlocking cost]]:
** 15{{zgold}} plus 100{{gold}} ''or''
** 80,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] 
* There is a rare [[Miniature Panda|miniature version]] of this animal.
{{bug|When the panda is viewed through a semi-transparent surface, like water, it disappears.}}

== Trivia ==
* The panda was removed as an animal companion from [[Guild Wars Factions|Factions]] just before its release in 2006; it was reintroduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20120209|February 9, 2012 game update]], as part of the conclusion of [[Winds of Change]].
** According to ANet, the pet was removed because China did not allow depictions of a dead member of an endangered species. <ref>[[Talk:Animal_companion/Archive#Fern_Lizard_and_Panda_Pet.3F|Comment by Gaile Gray]], Guild Wars Wiki</ref>
** Previously, the only panda in the game was [[Ling Wong]], who appears only during [[The Red Frog]]. 
** There was also a [[Panda (collector)|Panda]] that acted as a [[collector]] at the [[Farewell to Gaile]] in [[Shing Jea Monastery]].
